name: Tile-based Volume Ray Marching
definition: A volume rendering technique that stores 3D volume data in a 1D texture array organized into tiles, using ray marching to sample the volume and composite the result using front-to-back accumulation.
summary: Tile-based volume ray marching is a GPU-accelerated technique that partitions 3D volumes into Z-tiles to improve memory locality, distinguished by its explicit 1D array indexing scheme for finer control over tile dimensions and memory layout.
